norms.quote: Imported from `"void/auth"`. Client-side helpers imported from `"void/client"`.
norms.norm: Import defineAuth, getUser, getSession, getAuth and requireAuth from 'void/auth', and the browser helpers (auth, createAuthClient, fetch) from 'void/client'.
norms.detect: ImportDeclaration whose specifier is not 'void/auth' but imports one of defineAuth/getUser/getSession/getAuth/requireAuth (e.g. from 'void'); or imports `auth`/`createAuthClient` from anywhere but 'void/client' or 'void/client/<framework>'.

norms.quote: Customize Better Auth in a root-level `auth.ts` file.
norms.norm: Put the defineAuth(...) call in auth.ts at the project root (under sourceDir when sourceDir is set).
norms.detect: A file that calls defineAuth imported from 'void/auth' and is not named auth.ts (root, or <sourceDir>/auth.ts). Root vs sourceDir needs the config, so only the file name is checked reliably.

norms.quote: Spread `defaults` to keep Void's configuration:
norms.norm: Spread `defaults` into the object returned from the defineAuth callback, or Void's own auth configuration is lost.
norms.detect: In a defineAuth(cb) call, the object returned by cb has no SpreadElement of the identifier destructured as `defaults` from cb's parameter.
norms.good:
// auth.ts
export default defineAuth(({ defaults }) => ({ ...defaults, trustedOrigins: ['https://example.com'] }));

norms.quote: Returns the current authenticated user, or `null` when no user is present.
norms.norm: Handle the null return of getUser() before using the user.
norms.detect: The type of a getUser() result is AuthUser | null and a property is accessed on it without narrowing (overlaps with strictNullChecks).

norms.quote: Returns the current user and session, or `null` when signed out.
norms.norm: Handle the null return of getSession() before reading user or session.
norms.detect: The type of a getSession() result is AuthState | null and .user/.session is read without narrowing.

norms.quote: Enable [authentication](../../guide/auth.md) before calling this helper; it throws if no instance is available.
norms.norm: Enable authentication (auth.providers, or an auth import/auth.ts) before calling getAuth(c); it throws when no auth instance exists.
norms.detect: The doc says 'it throws if no instance is available'.
norms.bad: getAuth(c) in an app with no auth enabled

norms.quote: Call `requireAuth(c)` separately to require a signed-in user.
norms.norm: getAuth(c) works for anonymous requests; call requireAuth(c) separately when the route needs a signed-in user.
norms.detect: Whether a handler must be authenticated is intent; a lint cannot tell that getAuth(c) alone is a missing guard.
norms.bad: A route that calls getAuth(c).api.x with no requireAuth(c) where only members should reach it.

norms.quote: A cross-origin `POST` must come from a configured `trustedOrigins` entry for those cookies to be sent.
norms.norm: List every origin that posts cross-origin to a route using getAuth(c).api sign-in/sign-up calls in auth.ts trustedOrigins.
norms.detect: Needs knowledge of which origins call the route; spans auth.ts and callers.
norms.bad: Cross-origin sign-in POST with origin missing from trustedOrigins.
norms.good: Add the origin to trustedOrigins in auth.ts.

norms.quote: To send visitors to login instead, pass `throwRedirect`:
norms.norm: To send a signed-out visitor to a login page, pass { throwRedirect: '/login' } to requireAuth instead of letting the 401 reach the _error component.
norms.detect: Choosing a redirect over the 401 error page is a UX decision.
norms.bad: requireAuth(c) in a page loader where visitors should see the login page

norms.quote: `throwRedirect` works in loaders, actions, and middleware.
norms.norm: Use the throwRedirect option of requireAuth only in page loaders/actions (pages/**/*.server.*) and middleware, not in routes/ handlers.
norms.detect: requireAuth call with a throwRedirect option property in a file that is neither pages/**/*.server.* nor under middleware/. Route handlers in routes/ are not listed by the doc; helper functions called from loaders escape.
norms.bad:
// routes/me.ts
export const GET = defineHandler((c) => requireAuth(c, { throwRedirect: '/login' }));
norms.good:
// pages/me.server.ts
export const loader = defineHandler((c) => requireAuth(c, { throwRedirect: '/login' }));

norms.quote: Signing in does not repeat a rejected action.
norms.norm: Do not assume a page action rejected by requireAuth(..., { throwRedirect }) is replayed after login; the user must submit again.
norms.detect: Behavioral; depends on UX flow.
norms.good: Tell the user to resubmit or preserve the draft.

norms.quote: Choose a trusted destination in your app; validate any URL supplied by a user before passing it here.
norms.norm: Pass requireAuth's throwRedirect a trusted in-app path, never an unvalidated user-supplied URL.
norms.detect: The throwRedirect property value is not a string literal starting with a single '/', e.g. an expression reading c.req.query()/header/body. Validation done in another function escapes.

norms.quote: Your tsconfig needs the generated Void types for this
norms.norm: Make tsconfig.json include/extend the generated Void types so AuthUser carries plugin and additionalFields fields.
norms.detect: tsconfig is not linted JS; needs reading config.

norms.quote: Using Void's inferred auth types or auth helper results there creates a circular reference.
norms.norm: In auth.ts and files it imports, do not use Void's AuthUser/AuthSession/AuthState types or getUser/getSession/getAuth/requireAuth results; use Better Auth's User and Session types or let hook types infer.
norms.detect: In auth.ts, an import of AuthUser/AuthSession/AuthState (type) or getUser/getSession/getAuth/requireAuth from 'void/auth'. Modules imported by auth.ts are not checked.

norms.quote: This is a ready-to-use Better Auth client instance preconfigured with `basePath: "/api/auth"`.
norms.norm: Import the preconfigured `auth` client from 'void/client' instead of building a client with createAuthClient for the default setup.
norms.detect: A createAuthClient(...) call whose options only repeat basePath '/api/auth', or an import of createAuthClient from 'better-auth/*' in app code. Custom needs (advanced) escape.

norms.quote: For regular SPA apps that use Void for API/file routes without Void Pages mode, import the framework-specific client explicitly:
norms.norm: In a non-Pages SPA, import `auth` from the framework-specific subpath ('void/client/react', 'void/client/vue', 'void/client/svelte' or 'void/client/solid'), not 'void/client'.
norms.detect: Whether the app is Pages mode or a plain SPA is known from project layout/config, not from one file.
norms.bad: import { auth } from 'void/client'; // in a plain React SPA

norms.quote: Re-export of Better Auth's `createAuthClient` for advanced usage.
norms.norm: Reach for createAuthClient from 'void/client' only for advanced usage; use the ready-made `auth` otherwise.
norms.detect: Judging whether usage is 'advanced' needs intent.

norms.quote: Type-safe fetch client for calling your API routes from client code, built on top of [ofetch]
norms.norm: Call your own routes with `fetch` from 'void/client' (paths and types come from RouteMap), not the global fetch.
norms.detect: A call to the global `fetch` (no import from 'void/client') whose first argument is a string/template literal starting with '/'. The rule cannot know which paths are Void routes; absolute URLs and non-route paths must be allowed.

norms.quote: URL path parameters (`[id]` segments).
norms.norm: For a route path containing [param] segments, pass the values in options.params.
norms.detect: Call to void/client fetch whose first argument is a string literal containing '[' ... ']' and whose options object has no `params` property.

norms.quote: Non-GET calls require an explicit `method`, including calls that specify the method as a generic type argument.
norms.norm: Pass `method` explicitly for every non-GET call of void/client fetch; a body without method sends GET.
norms.detect: A call to `fetch` imported from 'void/client' whose options object has `body` (or no method but a generic type naming a non-GET method) and no `method` property.

norms.quote: Returns the parsed JSON response body, or `undefined` for 204 responses. Throws `FetchError` on non-2xx responses.
norms.norm: Expect undefined from void/client fetch on 204, and catch FetchError for non-2xx (status/data) instead of checking a Response.
norms.detect: Whether errors are handled correctly depends on intent and control flow.
norms.good: try { await fetch(...) } catch (e) { if (e instanceof FetchError) ... }

norms.quote: `Promise<T>`, which auto-parses JSON and returns the typed result directly
norms.norm: Do not call .json() on the result of void/client fetch; it already returns parsed data.
norms.detect: `.json()` called directly on `await fetch(...)` or on its awaited variable where fetch is from 'void/client'; aliases through other functions escape.

norms.quote: Route path with `[param]` interpolation from `options.params` + query string from `options.query`
norms.norm: Give void/client fetch the route pattern and put values in params/query; do not build the URL by template or concatenation.
norms.detect: First argument of void/client fetch is a TemplateLiteral with expressions or a BinaryExpression '+', or a string literal containing '?'.
norms.good: await fetch('/api/users/[id]', { params: { id }, query: { tab: 'a' } });

norms.quote: Auto-serializes `options.body` as JSON and sets `Content-Type: application/json`
norms.norm: Pass a plain object as `body` and do not JSON.stringify it or set Content-Type yourself.
norms.detect: In a void/client fetch call, the `body` option is a call to JSON.stringify, or headers sets Content-Type to application/json.

norms.quote: Constrains paths to `RouteMap` keys and methods to those defined per route. Invalid combinations fail at compile time.
norms.norm: Call void/client fetch only with paths that are RouteMap keys and methods defined for that route.
norms.detect: Type of the path argument is not assignable to keyof RouteMap (duplicates the TypeScript compile error).

norms.quote: Auto-retries on 408, 429, and 5xx (configurable via `retry` option)
norms.norm: void/client fetch retries on 408, 429 and 5xx; set `retry: 0` on mutating calls that are not idempotent.
norms.detect: Idempotency of an endpoint is a judgement; the doc states only the retry default.
norms.bad: POST that charges a card, with default retry

norms.quote: Imported from `"void/db"`. The `db` export is a
norms.norm: Use the `db` exported by 'void/db' (a Drizzle instance pre-wired to the configured dialect) instead of constructing drizzle() yourself.
norms.detect: Import of `drizzle` from 'drizzle-orm/d1', 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres' or 'drizzle-orm/mysql2' (or a call to drizzle(...)) in app code. Multi-DB setups should use createDb.

norms.quote: Default Drizzle instance, pre-wired with your schema from `db/schema.ts`.
norms.norm: Define the Drizzle schema in db/schema.ts (or db/schema/ re-exported from it).
norms.detect: A file that calls sqliteTable/pgTable/mysqlTable and is not db/schema.ts or under db/schema/ (or <sourceDir>/db/...).

norms.quote: PostgreSQL projects use `DATABASE_URL` during local development and Hyperdrive's `connectionString` in production, exposing `NodePgDatabase<Schema>`.
norms.norm: For PostgreSQL/MySQL projects set DATABASE_URL for local development (production uses Hyperdrive).
norms.detect: Environment content is not visible to a lint rule.

norms.quote: For D1 projects, pass a specific D1 binding.
norms.norm: On D1, call createDb with a D1 binding such as env.MY_OTHER_DB (use it for multiple databases or non-default bindings).
norms.detect: Which dialect is configured is not visible in the file.

norms.quote: For a fresh D1 read, pass `{ session: 'first-primary' }` and create the client inside the request.
norms.norm: When creating a D1 client with session 'first-primary', create it inside the request handler, not at module scope.
norms.detect: A createDb(...) call that has a `session` option and whose nearest enclosing function is none (module scope).
norms.bad: const db = createDb(env.DB, { session: 'first-primary' }); // top level
norms.good: export const GET = defineHandler((c) => { const db = createDb(c.env.DB, { session: 'first-primary' }); ... });

norms.quote: Use `getBookmark(client)` after queries to obtain the bookmark string to return to your client.
norms.norm: Call getBookmark(client) after the queries and return its value to the client if you need cross-request read-your-writes.
norms.detect: Ordering and data flow across a request.

norms.quote: For PostgreSQL and MySQL projects, pass a connection string.
norms.norm: On PostgreSQL/MySQL, call createDb with a connection string.
norms.detect: Dialect comes from void.config.ts, another file.

norms.quote: Call it in middleware before the first use of `db`.
norms.norm: Call setSession only from files under middleware/.
norms.detect: A call to setSession imported from 'void/db' in a file whose path is not under middleware/.

norms.quote: Call it in middleware before the first use of `db`.
norms.norm: Call setSession before any read of a property of `db` in the same request.
norms.detect: In one file, a member access on `db` (including destructuring or $client) that appears earlier in execution order than a setSession call. Use of db in other middleware escapes.

norms.quote: Wrap bookmark strings in an object, including strings returned by `getBookmark()`.
norms.norm: Pass setSession either 'first-primary', 'first-unconstrained' or { bookmark }; wrap bookmark strings, including getBookmark() results.
norms.detect: setSession argument is a string not equal to the two literals (e.g. a call to getBookmark() or a header value) rather than an object with `bookmark`.

norms.quote: If no incoming bookmark is available, pass `'first-unconstrained'`.
norms.norm: When the request carries no bookmark, call setSession('first-unconstrained') rather than passing null/undefined.
norms.detect: Needs data flow of where the bookmark comes from.

norms.quote: Use bookmarks only with the database that issued them. Keep client-side storage database-specific and clear saved bookmarks when switching databases
norms.norm: Never reuse a D1 bookmark with a different database; keep client-side bookmark storage per database and clear it when switching.
norms.detect: Spans client and server code.
norms.bad: One cookie for several databases' bookmarks

norms.quote: A newer bookmark or changing an opened session to `'first-primary'` throws.
norms.norm: Configure bookmark/first-primary before using db (or use createDb(binding, { session }) for an independent session); changing an opened session throws.
norms.detect: The doc says a newer bookmark or changing an opened session to 'first-primary' throws.

norms.quote: Await consistency-critical database work before capturing the bookmark you send to the client.
norms.norm: Await all consistency-critical queries before calling getBookmark(); deferred or background queries are not reflected.
norms.detect: Needs data flow across statements and waitUntil usage.

norms.quote: `setSession()` and the no-argument `getBookmark()` require Void's request scope.
norms.norm: Call setSession() and getBookmark() with no argument only inside Void's request scope; for framework-owned endpoints use an explicit client.
norms.detect: A call to setSession or no-argument getBookmark at module top level (no enclosing function). Calls in helper functions run outside a request escape.
norms.good: export const GET = defineHandler(() => ({ bm: getBookmark() }));

norms.quote: so you never need to depend on `drizzle-orm` directly
norms.norm: Import query operators (sql, eq, ne, gt, and, or, desc, like, inArray, ...) from 'void/db', not from 'drizzle-orm'.
norms.detect: ImportDeclaration from 'drizzle-orm' whose specifiers are in the void/db operator list: sql, eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, and, or, not, desc, asc, like, ilike, notLike, inArray, notInArray, isNull, isNotNull, between, notBetween, exists, notExists, count, sum, avg, min, max.

norms.quote: Use the exported Drizzle types `SQL`, `SQLWrapper`, `AnyColumn`, and `BatchItem` to type query helpers and batches:
norms.norm: Import the types SQL, SQLWrapper, AnyColumn and BatchItem from 'void/db', not from 'drizzle-orm'.
norms.detect: Import (including `import type`) of SQL/SQLWrapper/AnyColumn/BatchItem from 'drizzle-orm'.

norms.quote: // D1 only: `db.batch()` takes at least one query.
norms.norm: On D1, db.batch() needs at least one query; never pass an empty array.
norms.detect: db.batch([]) with an empty array literal. A runtime-built array that may be empty escapes.

norms.quote: Seed modules can export either `default` or a named `seed` function.
norms.norm: A seed module must export a default function or a named `seed` function (wrap it with defineSeed from 'void/seed').
norms.detect: A file importing defineSeed from 'void/seed' that has neither `export default` nor an export named `seed`.

norms.quote: Use `void/deploy` from Node.js to prepare a built Void app, SPA, or static site
norms.norm: Import 'void/deploy' only from Node.js tooling scripts, never from app code that runs in the Worker or browser.
norms.appliesTo: pages/, routes/, middleware/, crons/, queues/, email/, durable-objects/, client code
norms.detect: ImportDeclaration of 'void/deploy' in a file under any Void convention directory or any browser/Worker code.

norms.quote: Build the app in managed mode inside its isolated environment:
norms.norm: Build in managed mode (VOID_DEPLOY_BUILD=1 and VOID_DEPLOY_PROJECT_ID) inside the isolated environment before prepareDeployArtifact.
norms.detect: Environment variables set outside source files.

norms.quote: Keep the prepared result unchanged while requesting [publish approval]
norms.norm: Do not modify the prepareDeployArtifact result between preparation and publish approval.
norms.detect: Needs data flow through several steps.

norms.quote: Use this API for built Cloudflare Worker apps, SPAs, and static sites. For Node targets, Pages `output: 'static'`, remote data, deploy-time prerendering, Sandbox, or Live resources, use `void deploy`.
norms.norm: Use `void deploy`, not void/deploy, for Node targets, Pages output 'static', remote data, deploy-time prerendering, Sandbox or Live resources.
norms.detect: Depends on project features across files.
norms.bad: prepareDeployArtifact for an app using Sandbox

norms.quote: Run preparation inside the same isolated environment as the app build. App configuration and build plugins execute project code; keep platform credentials on the publishing server.
norms.norm: Run preparation in the isolated build environment and keep platform credentials only on the publishing server.
norms.detect: Operational, not source-level.

norms.quote: `prepareCfBuildOutput` follows Cloudflare's draft Build Output format. Its options and the prepared directory can change between Void releases.
norms.norm: Treat prepareCfBuildOutput as experimental; pin the Void version and expect option/directory changes.
norms.detect: Import of prepareCfBuildOutput from 'void/deploy' (report as experimental API).

norms.quote: Pass a Worker output directory containing a generated `wrangler.json`, such as `dist/ssr` or `dist/server`.
norms.norm: Pass prepareCfBuildOutput a Worker output directory that contains a generated wrangler.json (or the project root with .cloudflare/output/v1).
norms.detect: Needs filesystem state.

norms.quote: Rebuild artifacts made with an older Void version before preparing them with the updated toolchain.
norms.norm: Rebuild artifacts built with an older Void before preparing them with a newer one.
norms.detect: Needs version knowledge.

norms.quote: For Containers built from a local Dockerfile, publish from the same Docker environment used to build the image.
norms.norm: Publish Containers built from a local Dockerfile from the same Docker environment that built the image.
norms.detect: Environment.

norms.quote: Dispose the result after publication.
norms.norm: Call dispose() on the prepareCfBuildOutput result after publication (use try/finally).
norms.detect: A variable assigned from `await prepareCfBuildOutput(...)` with no `.dispose()` call anywhere in the same function (ideally inside finally). Disposal in another function escapes.

norms.quote: Unsupported configurations return `null`; missing or invalid build files throw an error.
norms.norm: Check the prepareCfBuildOutput result for null before using it.
norms.detect: The result type is non-nullable-narrowed: a property access on a prepareCfBuildOutput result whose type includes null without a null check.

norms.quote: The returned object must be the default export of a module under `durable-objects/`; named-export the same object for typed RPC calls elsewhere in the app.
norms.norm: Default-export the defineDurableState() result from a module under durable-objects/.
norms.detect: A file that calls defineDurableState (from 'void/durable') is not under durable-objects/ (or <sourceDir>/durable-objects/), or lacks an `export default` that is that call/identifier.

norms.quote: The returned object must be the default export of a module under `durable-objects/`; named-export the same object for typed RPC calls elsewhere in the app.
norms.norm: Also named-export the durable state object when other modules call its methods via typed RPC.
norms.detect: A durable-objects/ module with a default-exported defineDurableState result and no named export of the same binding. Whether any other file needs the RPC import is not visible.

norms.quote: Run `void info` and pin the displayed name before renaming a deployed definition.
norms.norm: Before renaming a deployed durable-state file, run `void info` and set `name` to the displayed name.
norms.detect: Needs deployment history, not one file.

norms.quote: Keep instance names passed to `get()` unchanged.
norms.norm: Keep the instance names passed to get() unchanged across releases or state is lost.
norms.detect: Needs history across commits.

norms.quote: Both require `messages.client` and `messages.server` Standard Schema validators
norms.norm: Give defineRoom() and defineWebSocket() a `messages` option with `client` and `server` Standard Schema validators.
norms.detect: A defineRoom/defineWebSocket call (from 'void/ws') whose options object lacks messages, or messages lacks client or server.
norms.good: defineRoom({ messages: { client: v.object({}), server: v.object({}) } })

norms.quote: Run `void info` before moving a deployed route and pin its displayed name.
norms.norm: Before moving a deployed WebSocket route file, run `void info` and pin `name` to the displayed name.
norms.detect: Needs deployment history.

norms.quote: A callback must return a stable string synchronously.
norms.norm: The `key` callback of defineRoom/defineWebSocket must return a stable string synchronously (no async, no Promise).
norms.detect: The `key` option is an async function, contains await, or returns a Promise-valued expression. Non-deterministic sync returns (random, Date.now) are only caught by a heuristic.

norms.quote: When renaming parameters, preserve the complete old key to retain state.
norms.norm: When renaming route parameters, keep the complete old key through the `key` callback to retain state.
norms.detect: Needs history of the route.

norms.quote: Void auto-discovers `env.ts`, imports it during dev/build/deploy
norms.norm: Declare the env schema with defineEnv in env.ts at the project root (under sourceDir when set), default-exported.
norms.detect: A file that calls defineEnv from 'void/env' and is not named env.ts, or env.ts without a default export of that call. Root vs sourceDir location needs config.

norms.quote: Typed runtime proxy for declared env keys. Unknown keys and bindings pass through as `unknown`.
norms.norm: Declare every key you read from `env` (void/env) in env.ts; undeclared keys are typed unknown.
norms.detect: A member access on `env` imported from 'void/env' whose resulting type is unknown (key missing from env.ts).

norms.quote: Non-client keys are server values and use remote secret storage in production. `VITE_*` keys are public build-time client values.
norms.norm: Never put a secret in a VITE_* key; only VITE_* keys reach client code, as public build-time values.
norms.detect: defineEnv property name starting with VITE_ and containing SECRET, KEY, TOKEN, PASSWORD (heuristic); names are the only signal.

norms.quote: Non-client keys are server values and use remote secret storage in production. `VITE_*` keys are public build-time client values.
norms.norm: Read non-VITE_ env keys only in server code, not in browser components.
norms.detect: In a browser file (pages/ component, not .server.*), a member access env.X from 'void/env' where X does not start with VITE_.

norms.quote: Declares the `Cloudflare.Env` namespace with `DB`, `KV`, `STORAGE`, `AI`, `SANDBOX`, and `ASSETS` binding types.
norms.norm: Reference 'void/env' types (triple-slash) to get the Cloudflare.Env binding types if they are not already included via the generated tsconfig.
norms.detect: Whether tsconfig already pulls the types is not visible.

norms.quote: For handler context variables such as `c.set()` and `c.get()`, augment [`CloudContextVariables`](./types.md#cloudcontextvariables).
norms.norm: Type c.set()/c.get() variables by augmenting CloudContextVariables, not Cloudflare.Env (which types bindings).
norms.detect: Which interface an augmentation targets is semantic.

norms.quote: Wraps a route handler function. The handler receives a [`CloudContext`]
norms.norm: Wrap each exported HTTP method handler in routes/ with defineHandler from 'void'.
norms.detect: In a routes/ file (not _-prefixed), an export named GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS whose value is not a defineHandler(...)/defineHandler.withValidator(...)(...) call.

norms.quote: Composes up to 5 per-route middleware with a final handler.
norms.norm: Pass at most 5 middleware functions plus the final handler to defineHandler.
norms.detect: A defineHandler call with more than 6 arguments.

norms.quote: Creates a handler with input validation using any [Standard Schema]
norms.norm: Validate input with defineHandler.withValidator and a Standard Schema library (zod, valibot, arktype); do not hand-validate inside the handler.
norms.detect: Spotting hand-written validation needs judgement.

norms.quote: Returns a curried function that accepts the handler.
norms.norm: Call withValidator(validators) first and pass the handler to the returned function: withValidator({...})((c, input) => ...).
norms.detect: A defineHandler.withValidator(...) call with two or more arguments, or whose result is not immediately called.

norms.quote: Validated input is passed as the second argument to the handler.
norms.norm: Read validated body/query/params from the handler's second argument, not from c.req.
norms.detect: Handler passed to withValidator takes fewer than 2 parameters, or reads c.req.json()/c.req.query()/c.req.param() for a slot that is validated.

norms.quote: The inferred output types of each validator slot.
norms.norm: Use only the slots body, query and params in the object passed to withValidator.
norms.detect: withValidator object literal with a key other than body, query, params.

norms.quote: Use it from `middleware/` with credentials from `void/env` to protect the whole app
norms.norm: Take basicAuth credentials from void/env, not string literals in source.
norms.detect: basicAuth option username/password is a string literal.

norms.quote: reserved `/__void` endpoints use their own authentication
norms.norm: Do not define your own routes under /__void; those paths are reserved by Void.
norms.detect: A route file whose path is routes/__void/** or routes/__void.*. Rewrites/headers config targets escape.

norms.quote: When credentials come from `void/env`, wrap the reads in functions so they are resolved per request after Void has bound the runtime env.
norms.norm: Pass basicAuth username/password (and realm/message) from void/env as functions: () => env.X.
norms.detect: A basicAuth options property value that is a MemberExpression on `env` imported from 'void/env' instead of an arrow/function returning it.

norms.quote: If `password` resolves to an empty value, requests fail with a server error instead of passing the gate.
norms.norm: Make sure basicAuth's password resolves to a non-empty value.
norms.detect: The doc says requests fail with a server error when password is empty.

norms.quote: For app-specific bypasses such as health checks or public webhooks, compose that logic in your own middleware before calling `basicAuth()`.
norms.norm: Implement bypasses (health checks, public webhooks) in your own middleware before basicAuth; do not expect options for it.
norms.detect: Which paths should bypass is app intent.

norms.quote: The generic `<T>` defines the message body type, which flows through to the typed `queues` proxy for `send()` calls.
norms.norm: Give defineQueue an explicit type argument for the message body so queues.send() is typed.
norms.detect: A defineQueue(...) call with no type arguments and a handler whose batch parameter is not annotated QueueBatch<T>.

norms.quote: The second argument provides pre-built `<head>` and `<body>` asset tags for injecting client scripts and styles.
norms.norm: In a defineRender handler, inject assetTags.css and assetTags.preloads in <head> and assetTags.body before </body>.
norms.detect: Needs reading the produced HTML template.

norms.quote: Type-safe wrapper for the page `head()` export in `.server.ts` files.

norms.detect: In pages/**/*.server.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mts,mjs}, `export const head`/`export function head` whose value is not a defineHead call.
norms.bad: export const head = (c, p) => ({ title: p.t });

norms.quote: Build a URL with [`routeUrl()`](./types.md#routeurl-path-options) and pass it to `Link`'s `href`.
norms.norm: Build Link hrefs for your own routes with routeUrl() rather than string concatenation.
norms.detect: A Link `href` that is a TemplateLiteral with expressions or a '+' BinaryExpression. Plain literals and external URLs are fine.

norms.quote: With [`routing.typedRoutes`](../config.md#routing-typedroutes), `href` and router strings must match one of your routes, or be a same-page or external URL.
norms.norm: With routing.typedRoutes on, Link href and router.visit/prefetch/flush strings must be routes, same-page queries/hashes, or external URLs.
norms.detect: The type of the href / destination argument is `string` instead of Href/RouteUrlInput (duplicates the TypeScript error).

norms.quote: Combine strategies with an array such as `['visible', 'hover']`. The first one triggered loads the page; later triggers reuse it.
norms.norm: Use only the prefetch strategies 'hover', 'click', 'mount', 'visible' (or true/false, or an array of them).
norms.appliesTo: Link prefetch prop, plugin prefetch option
norms.detect: A `prefetch`/`defaultStrategy` literal not in {true,false,'hover','click','mount','visible'} or an array of those strategies.

norms.quote: Only same-origin GET links prefetch.
norms.norm: Do not rely on prefetch for cross-origin or non-GET links; they never prefetch.
norms.detect: Whether a target is same-origin is runtime/URL knowledge.

norms.quote: Set `cacheFor` in milliseconds or as a duration such as `'5m'`.
norms.norm: Give cacheFor as milliseconds, a duration string such as '5m', or a [fresh, stale] pair of durations.
norms.detect: A cacheFor literal that is neither a number, a string, nor a two-string array. Valid duration units are not enumerated in the doc, so the string format is not checked.

norms.quote: Imported from `"@void/vue/plugin"`.
norms.norm: Import voidVue from '@void/vue/plugin' and the runtime from '@void/vue'.
norms.detect: Import of voidVue from any specifier other than '@void/vue/plugin'.

norms.quote: It already includes `@vitejs/plugin-vue`, so you do not need to install or configure that separately.
norms.norm: Do not add @vitejs/plugin-vue to the Vite plugins next to voidVue(); pass its options through the `vue` option.
norms.detect: vite.config file whose plugins array calls voidVue() and also imports/calls the default export of '@vitejs/plugin-vue'. Plugins added through helper functions escape.

norms.quote: Vue component for SPA navigation. Renders `<a>` for GET, `<button>` for non-GET methods.
norms.norm: Import the runtime exports (Link, useRouter, useParams, useNavigation, useForm, useIslandForm, action, isVoidActionError, isCallSiteActionError, getValidationErrors, useShared, Form) from '@void/vue'.
norms.detect: Import of those names from a specifier other than '@void/vue' (e.g. 'void', 'void/pages').

norms.quote: Pass the page's pattern as the type argument, such as `useParams<'/users/[id]'>()`, to type them.
norms.norm: Call useParams with the page pattern as the type argument.
norms.detect: A call to useParams (from '@void/vue') with no type arguments.

norms.quote: `null` and `undefined` are omitted, and nested objects throw.
norms.norm: Do not put nested objects in a GET <Link data>; use primitives or arrays only.
norms.detect: JSX Link (from '@void/vue') without method (or method="get") whose `data` object literal has an object/array-of-object value.

norms.quote: `prefetch` and `reloadDocument` are GET-only and throw for mutation links.
norms.norm: Do not put prefetch or reloadDocument on a Link with a non-GET method.
norms.detect: JSX Link (from '@void/vue') with a `method` attribute other than get that also has `prefetch` or `reloadDocument`. Void also throws at runtime.

norms.quote: Vue GET navigation remounts the page so `useForm()` picks up the destination record's URL and defaults; layouts persist.
norms.norm: Do not assume page state survives Vue GET navigation; set preserveState explicitly when you need to override the default within the same record.
norms.detect: Behavior depends on intended UX.
norms.bad: relying on state surviving GET nav

norms.detect: JSX Link (from '@void/react') with a `method` attribute other than get that also has `prefetch` or `reloadDocument`. Void also throws at runtime.

norms.norm: In React pages, read deferred props with React's use() inside a <Suspense> boundary.
norms.detect: A component whose props type includes Deferred<T> and reads the prop without passing it to use(), or a use() call with no enclosing <Suspense> in the same file.

norms.quote: `use()`, so use a normal React error boundary for custom deferred error UI.
norms.norm: Handle rejected deferred props in React with an error boundary, not try/catch around use().
norms.detect: use(<Deferred>) inside a try block.

norms.norm: Import the Deferred type from the adapter package (@void/react, @void/vue, @void/svelte, @void/solid), not from another module.
norms.detect: Import of `Deferred` from a specifier that is not an '@void/<adapter>' package.

norms.quote: When awaiting navigation inside `startTransition`, a `<form action>`, `useActionState`, or an async `useForm()` callback, pass `{ resolveOn: 'data' }`:
norms.norm: Pass { resolveOn: 'data' } when awaiting router.visit/refresh inside startTransition, a form action, useActionState or an async useForm callback.
norms.detect: await router.visit(...)/router.refresh(...) inside a function passed to startTransition/useActionState/useForm onSuccess|onError or used as a <form action>, without `resolveOn: 'data'` in the options. Helper indirection escapes.

norms.quote: The DOM and URL may still show the previous page after `await`. Use an effect or ref callback for work that needs the updated DOM.
norms.norm: After awaiting navigation with resolveOn 'data', do DOM-dependent work in an effect or ref callback.
norms.detect: Data flow after await.

norms.detect: vite.config file whose plugins array calls voidSvelte() and also imports/calls the default export of '@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte'. Plugins added through helper functions escape.

norms.quote: so read props inside JSX or memos instead of copying them in the component body.
norms.norm: In Solid pages read props inside JSX or memos; do not destructure props or copy them into plain variables in the component body.
norms.detect: A component destructuring its props parameter or assigning `const x = props.y` in the component body outside JSX/createMemo/createEffect.

norms.quote: The optional `@void/md` package adds Markdown pages to Pages Routing. Install it alongside a Pages adapter and add `voidMarkdown()` to your Vite plugins.
norms.norm: Add voidMarkdown() from '@void/md/plugin' to the Vite plugins when using @void/md.
norms.detect: vite.config imports from '@void/md/plugin' but its plugins array has no voidMarkdown() call (or the reverse: @void/md imported in pages without it).

norms.quote: `FrontmatterContext` and `setFrontmatter()` are deprecated. Use `useFrontmatter()`.
norms.norm: Use useFrontmatter() from '@void/md'; do not use the deprecated FrontmatterContext or setFrontmatter().
norms.detect: Import or use of FrontmatterContext or setFrontmatter from '@void/md'.

norms.quote: Pass the object returned by `useForm()` as `form`; `method` defaults to `post`.
norms.norm: Pass the object returned by useForm() as the `form` prop of <Form>.
norms.detect: JSX <Form> from an adapter whose `form` attribute is not an identifier initialised from useForm() in the same file.

norms.quote: Named export from `"void"`. Returns an array of Vite plugins that set up file-based routing
norms.norm: Import voidPlugin from 'void' and include voidPlugin() in vite.config.ts plugins.
norms.detect: Import of voidPlugin from a specifier other than 'void'; or the vite.config default export calling none.

norms.quote: Application-level configuration is read from [`void.config.ts`](../config.md); the optional `options` object controls Vite/Cloudflare plugin behavior.
norms.norm: Put app-level configuration (routing, auth, inference...) in void.config.ts; give voidPlugin() only persistTo and auxiliaryWorkers.
norms.detect: A voidPlugin({...}) call whose object has a key other than persistTo or auxiliaryWorkers.

norms.quote: Each entry accepts `configPath` (JSON, JSONC, or TOML), `config` (settings or a callback), `viteEnvironment`, and `devOnly`.
norms.norm: Each auxiliaryWorkers entry may only use configPath, config, viteEnvironment and devOnly.
norms.detect: In voidPlugin({ auxiliaryWorkers: [...] }) an object literal entry with a key other than those four. Entries built outside the literal escape.

norms.quote: Import from `void/config` in the root `void.config.ts`.
norms.norm: Import defineConfig from 'void/config' in the root void.config.ts (not from vite).
norms.detect: In void.config.ts, a defineConfig import from a specifier other than 'void/config', or a default export that is not defineConfig(...).

norms.quote: Default [R2 bucket](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/) proxy for the inferred `STORAGE` binding.
norms.norm: Use the `storage` client from 'void/storage' (and `kv` from 'void/kv', `ai` from 'void/ai') so bindings are inferred; do not hand-declare them.
norms.detect: Import from 'void/*' modules other than the documented list, or use of c.env.STORAGE/KV/AI where the void clients exist (detection is import-based).

norms.quote: AI methods return promises and reject usage limits with `UsageLimit` from `void/limits`.
norms.norm: Let UsageLimit rejections from ai calls propagate in routes and page actions (Void returns HTTP 429), or catch them with `instanceof UsageLimit` from 'void/limits'.
norms.detect: Needs intent on error handling.
norms.good: let it propagate or instanceof UsageLimit

norms.quote: Default secret names for `ai.provider()`. Use `apiKeyEnv` to choose another name.
norms.norm: Set the provider API key under its default secret name (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY for 'openai'), or pass apiKeyEnv to name another secret.
norms.detect: Secrets live outside the file.

norms.quote: Revalidate ISR-cached pages on demand. In local development this is a no-op because there is no edge ISR cache.
norms.norm: Do not rely on revalidate() having an effect in local development; it is a no-op.
norms.detect: Behavior in dev vs production.

norms.quote: With [`routing.typedRoutes`](../config.md#routing-typedroutes), each path must match one of your routes.
norms.norm: With typedRoutes, pass revalidate({ paths }) values built with routeUrl() or cast with `as RouteUrl` after validating at runtime.
norms.detect: An element of the paths array has type string instead of RouteUrl.

norms.quote: **Methods:** `logger.error(message, fields?)`, `logger.warn(message, fields?)`, `logger.info(message, fields?)`, `logger.child(fields)`.
norms.norm: Use only logger.error, logger.warn, logger.info and logger.child from 'void/log'.
norms.detect: A member call on `logger` imported from 'void/log' whose property is not error, warn, info or child (e.g. debug, log).

norms.quote: `destination` must start with `/`
norms.norm: A string passed to c.rewrite() must start with '/'.
norms.detect: c.rewrite call whose first argument is a string literal (or template starting with a literal) not beginning with '/'.

norms.quote: With [`routing.typedRoutes`](../config.md#routing-typedroutes), a string destination must be a [`RouteUrl`](./types.md#route-types)
norms.norm: With typedRoutes, pass c.rewrite a RouteUrl or RouteDestination; cast runtime-built paths with `as RouteUrl`.
norms.detect: c.rewrite argument type is string instead of RouteUrl/RouteDestination (duplicates TypeScript).

norms.quote: `c.redirect()` checks strings like a link: route URLs, same-page queries and hashes
norms.norm: With typedRoutes, c.redirect accepts route URLs, same-page queries/hashes, http/https/mailto/tel URLs, URL objects or typed destinations; use `as Href` for others.
norms.detect: c.redirect argument of type string not assignable to Href.

norms.quote: A cast skips the type check; Void doesn't validate redirect destinations at runtime.
norms.norm: Validate request-derived redirect targets (e.g. ?redirectTo=) by checking the origin before c.redirect; casts and Void do not validate.
norms.detect: c.redirect/c.rewrite whose argument comes straight from c.req.query()/header()/body, possibly wrapped in `as Href`/`as RouteUrl`, with no origin comparison in the same function.
norms.good: const u = new URL(c.req.query('redirectTo') ?? '/', c.req.url); c.redirect(u.origin === new URL(c.req.url).origin ? u : '/')

norms.quote: `destination` must start with a single `/` and point at an internal path.
norms.norm: Do not rewrite to external URLs, '//host' or relative paths; use fetch() for cross-origin calls.
norms.detect: The doc says such destinations 'throw immediately'.

norms.quote: Destinations whose final path segment ends in a known static-asset extension
norms.norm: Do not c.rewrite to static assets (.png, .css, .json ...); use a static routing.rewrites rule or a _redirects 200! entry.
norms.detect: The doc says such destinations throw VoidAssetRewriteError before the re-dispatch.

norms.quote: Middleware re-runs on every rewrite hop. Guard side-effects with [`c.isRewritten()`](#c-originalurl-c-isrewritten).
norms.norm: Guard middleware side-effects (logging, counters) with c.isRewritten() because middleware re-runs on every rewrite hop.
norms.detect: Which statements are side-effects is a judgement.

norms.quote: Client-side SPA navigation via `Link` does not trigger server rewrites; only full HTTP requests do.
norms.norm: Do not rely on server rewrites for client-side Link navigation; only full HTTP requests are rewritten.
norms.detect: Runtime behavior.
norms.bad: Link to a path that only exists via rewrite

norms.quote: Purge the destination path to clear rewritten [ISR entries]
norms.norm: Revalidate the rewrite destination path, not the browser URL, to purge rewritten ISR entries.
norms.detect: Needs routing knowledge.

norms.quote: `c.originalUrl()` returns the pre-rewrite URL as a `URL` object, or `null` on the first, non-rewritten hop.
norms.norm: Handle null from c.originalUrl() on the first, non-rewritten hop.
norms.detect: Property access on a c.originalUrl() result typed URL | null without narrowing.

norms.quote: The context variables type used by `c.set()` / `c.get()`. Augment this interface to add typed variables that flow through all middleware and handlers:
norms.norm: Add typed context variables by augmenting CloudContextVariables with `declare module 'void' { interface CloudContextVariables { ... } }`.
norms.detect: A `declare module` block whose module name is not 'void' but declares CloudContextVariables; or an interface CloudContextVariables outside a module augmentation of 'void'.
norms.bad: declare module 'void/types' { interface CloudContextVariables { x: string } }
norms.good: declare module 'void' { interface CloudContextVariables { requestId: string } }

norms.quote: Generated route types used by the typed `fetch` client. Contains each route’s methods, inputs, and outputs.
norms.norm: Import RouteMap and the route types from 'void/routes' (generated virtual module), not from 'void'.
norms.detect: Import of RouteMap/RouteUrl/Href/RoutePath/PagePath/PageParams/RouteOptions/RouteDestination/RouteUrlInput/RouteQuery/RoutePathMap/PagePathMap/RewriteDestination from a specifier other than 'void/routes'.

norms.quote: Required for dynamic routes. Each parameter accepts a `string` or `number`.
norms.norm: Pass routeUrl `params` for dynamic route patterns, with string or number values.
norms.detect: routeUrl call for a pattern containing [..] with no params, or with non-string/number values.

norms.quote: Pass raw parameter values for URL encoding.
norms.norm: Pass raw values to routeUrl params; do not encodeURIComponent them first.
norms.detect: A property of the params object in routeUrl(...) is a call to encodeURIComponent/encodeURI.

norms.quote: Invalid or missing path parameters throw a `TypeError`.
norms.norm: Supply every path parameter to routeUrl; invalid or missing ones throw a TypeError.
norms.detect: The doc says invalid or missing path parameters throw a TypeError.

norms.quote: Annotate a dynamic page's `getPrerenderPaths()` as `Promise[]>` so TypeScript checks those param names.
norms.norm: Annotate getPrerenderPaths in a dynamic page as returning Promise[]>.
norms.detect: In a pages/ .server file whose path has a [param] segment and which exports getPrerenderPaths, the function has no return type annotation mentioning PageParams.
norms.bad: export async function getPrerenderPaths() { return [{ slug: 'a' }]; }

norms.quote: File-based HTTP API endpoints built on [Hono](https://hono.dev). Each file exports named HTTP method handlers.
norms.norm: Each file in routes/ exports named HTTP method handlers (GET, POST, ...), not a default export.
norms.detect: A file under routes/ (name not starting with _, not .ws.) with no export named GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS, or with an `export default`.

norms.quote: **Extensions**: `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mts`, or `.mjs`; use `.tsx` or `.jsx` for JSX handlers
norms.norm: Name route files with .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mts/.mjs and use .tsx or .jsx when the handler contains JSX.
norms.detect: A file under routes/ containing JSX but with extension .ts/.js/.mts/.mjs, or with an extension outside the six (e.g. .cts).

norms.quote: **Dynamic segments**: `[id]` becomes `:id` route parameter
norms.norm: Write dynamic route segments as [id] directory/file names, not :id, {id} or $id.
norms.detect: A path segment under routes/ or pages/ containing ':' , '$' or '{' (route syntax from other frameworks).

norms.quote: **Catch-all**: `[...slug]` matches the remaining path
norms.norm: Write catch-all segments as [...name].
norms.detect: A path segment of the form [name...], [*name], or '*' instead of [...name].

norms.quote: - **Files starting with `_`** are ignored
norms.norm: Put non-route helper modules in routes/ only with a leading underscore; every other file there is registered as a route.
norms.detect: A file under routes/ not starting with _ that has no HTTP-method exports (helper module that becomes a route). Note the doc says files; AGENTS-style repos also treat _-prefixed directories as ignored, which the doc does not state.

norms.quote: - **Environment suffix**: `debug.dev.ts` builds in development only, `metrics.prod.ts` in production only
norms.norm: Never import a *.dev.* route/page file from code that ships to production, and vice versa for *.prod.*.
norms.detect: An import specifier whose last path segment ends with .dev or .prod (before extension) from a file that does not itself carry the same suffix.

norms.quote: - **`.server.ts` (or `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mts`, `.mjs`) files** export `loader` for `GET` data and `action` for mutations, paired with the page component of the same name
norms.norm: In pages/, put GET data in a `loader` and mutations in `action` exported from a .server file next to the page component of the same name.
norms.detect: A pages/*.server.* file exporting GET/POST/default handlers instead of loader/action, or without a sibling component file of the same base name (needs a filesystem check).

norms.quote: - **Environment suffix**: `debug.dev.tsx` is served in development only, `stats.prod.tsx` in production only
norms.norm: Do not link to or import a *.dev.* page from production pages; *.dev.tsx exists only in development.
norms.detect: Link href or import resolving to a *.dev page from a file without that suffix.

norms.quote: Global middleware that runs on every request. Numeric prefixes control execution order.
norms.norm: Prefix middleware file names with a number (01.logger.ts, 02.auth.ts) to set execution order.
norms.detect: A file directly under middleware/ whose name does not match ^\d+\..

norms.quote: Each file default-exports a `defineMiddleware()` handler.
norms.norm: Default-export a defineMiddleware(...) handler from each middleware/ file.
norms.detect: A middleware/ file without `export default`, or whose default export is not a defineMiddleware(...) call (basicAuth(...) is shown as a default export in the handlers doc and must be allowed).

norms.quote: - `db/schema.ts`: your Drizzle table definitions and the source of truth for DB types
norms.norm: Keep Drizzle table definitions in db/schema.ts (the source of truth).
norms.detect: sqliteTable/pgTable/mysqlTable calls in a file outside db/schema.ts and db/schema/.

norms.quote: - `db/schema/`: optional. Split tables into separate files and re-export them from `db/schema.ts`
norms.norm: When tables are split under db/schema/, re-export them from db/schema.ts.
norms.detect: db/schema.ts that defines no tables and has no `export * from './schema/...'` re-exports (only meaningful when db/schema.ts exists; the AGENTS-style layout with only db/schema/ is not described by the doc).

norms.quote: - `db/migrations/`: generated SQL migration files, applied in order on deploy
norms.norm: Create migration files with `void db generate`; they are SQL files applied in order on deploy.
norms.detect: File generation workflow.

norms.quote: Generate schema with `void gen model` or write it by hand. Generate migrations with `void db generate`.
norms.norm: Generate the schema with `void gen model` or write it by hand; generate migrations with `void db generate`.
norms.detect: CLI workflow.

norms.quote: [Scheduled jobs](/guide/jobs). Each file exports a `cron` expression and a default `defineScheduled()` handler.
norms.norm: Each crons/ file exports a `cron` expression and default-exports a defineScheduled(...) handler.
norms.detect: A file under crons/ without a named export `cron`, or without `export default` of a defineScheduled call.

norms.quote: [Scheduled jobs](/guide/jobs). Each file exports a `cron` expression and a default `defineScheduled()` handler.
norms.norm: Make the exported `cron` a string literal (a cron expression) so Void can read it at build time.
norms.detect: `export const cron` whose initialiser is not a string literal. The literal requirement is inferred from how Void reads it, not stated outright.

norms.quote: [Queue consumers](/guide/queues). Each file default-exports a `defineQueue()` handler.
norms.norm: Default-export a defineQueue(...) handler from each queues/ file.
norms.detect: A file under queues/ without `export default` of a defineQueue call.

norms.quote: A file's name selects the recipient; `_default.ts` handles other addresses.
norms.norm: Name each email/ handler file after the recipient it handles and use _default.ts for all other addresses.
norms.detect: Valid recipient names and routing are defined in the email guide, not here; note the leading underscore in _default.ts is meaningful here.

norms.quote: [Durable State](/guide/durable-state) modules. Each file default-exports a `defineDurableState()` definition.
norms.norm: Default-export a defineDurableState(...) definition from each durable-objects/ file.
norms.detect: A file under durable-objects/ with no `export default` of a defineDurableState call.

norms.quote: Static assets served as-is at the root path. Files here are not processed by Vite.
norms.norm: Put static assets in public/ and reference them by root path; do not import files from public/ as modules.
norms.detect: An ImportDeclaration whose specifier contains '/public/' or starts with 'public/'.

norms.quote: Generated types and local development state (gitignored). Run `void prepare` to create the types, or let `vite dev` and `vite build` update them.
norms.norm: Keep .void/ out of version control and do not hand-edit it; regenerate with `void prepare`.
norms.detect: Repository hygiene, not code.

norms.quote: | `vite.config.ts` | Vite configuration. Must include `voidPlugin()`.
norms.norm: Include voidPlugin() in vite.config.ts.
norms.detect: The default-exported config in vite.config.* has no voidPlugin() call in its plugins.

norms.quote: TypeScript config. Extend `.void/tsconfig.json` for auto-generated types; run `void init --tsconfig` when an existing config already uses `extends`.
norms.norm: Make tsconfig.json extend .void/tsconfig.json (use `void init --tsconfig` if it already has `extends`).
norms.detect: Config file is not linted JS.

norms.quote: Local development values only (gitignored; never deployed)
norms.norm: Treat .env as local-only; it is never deployed, so production values must be secrets or worker.vars.
norms.detect: Not source code.

norms.quote: Checked-in env names, types, defaults, and requiredness
norms.norm: Keep env names, types, defaults and requiredness in env.ts, checked in; keep values in .env or secrets.
norms.detect: Content judgement.

norms.quote: | filename-derived | `DurableObjectNamespace`   | A default-exported `defineDurableState()` module in `durable-objects/`
norms.norm: Default-export defineDurableState() from durable-objects/ for it to be detected; the file name derives the binding.
norms.detect: Same as the durable.md rule: defineDurableState used outside durable-objects/ or not default-exported.

norms.quote: Auth detection also triggers when importing the `auth` specifier from `void/client` or a framework-specific client subpath such as `void/client/react` (but not when importing only `fetch`).
norms.norm: Import `auth` (not only `fetch`) from void/client or a framework subpath to enable auth inference.
norms.detect: Intent: whether auth is wanted.

norms.quote: `const { DB, KV: cache } = c.env` are also detected. For keys chosen at runtime,
norms.norm: Access bindings by static names (c.env.DB, c.env['KV'], destructuring); for runtime-chosen keys declare inference.bindings explicitly.
norms.detect: A computed member access `c.env[expr]` or `env[expr]` whose key is not a string literal; spread of c.env.

norms.quote: Native Void apps scan these directories by default. With [`sourceDir`](./config.md#sourcedir) configured, Void scans that source tree instead:
norms.norm: Import void/db, void/kv, void/storage, void/ai, void/auth etc. only in files under the scanned directories (routes/, middleware/, queues/, pages/, crons/, email/, src/, durable-objects/, or sourceDir/inference.scanDirs).
norms.detect: File importing a resource module (void/db|kv|storage|ai|auth|sandbox|queues|live) that sits in a top-level directory outside that set (e.g. lib/, server/). Needs void.config.ts scanDirs/sourceDir to be exact.

norms.quote: Framework detection uses `package.json` dependencies and dev dependencies. Add `voidPlugin()` to your framework's Vite config to enable inference during development.
norms.norm: For supported meta frameworks, add voidPlugin() to the framework's Vite config to enable inference in development.
norms.detect: Depends on package.json.

norms.quote: Paths are relative to the project root. When `inference.scanDirs` is set, it replaces the default directories entirely.
norms.norm: When setting inference.scanDirs, list every directory that holds resource imports (including routes/ and pages/), since it replaces the defaults.
norms.detect: In void.config.ts a scanDirs array literal that omits conventional directories existing on disk (routes, pages, middleware, ...). Needs a filesystem listing.

norms.quote: Use [`inference.bindings`](./config.md#inference-bindings) to enable, disable, or rename a binding when inference does not match your setup.
norms.norm: Use inference.bindings to enable, disable or rename a binding when inference does not match.
norms.detect: Needs knowledge of what inference got wrong.

norms.quote: Put server resource imports in these files or a page's `.server.ts` companion; Vue and Svelte component files are not scanned directly.
norms.norm: Put resource imports (void/db, void/kv, ...) in .ts/.tsx/.mts/.js/.jsx/.mjs or a page's .server file, never only in .vue or .svelte files.
norms.detect: A .vue or .svelte file importing 'void/db', 'void/kv', 'void/storage', 'void/ai', 'void/auth', 'void/sandbox', 'void/queues' or 'void/live'.

norms.quote: Put `void.config.ts` at the project root and import `defineConfig` from `void/config`.
norms.norm: Keep void.config.ts at the project root, default-exporting defineConfig from 'void/config'.
norms.detect: A void.config.ts that is not beside package.json, or whose default export is not a defineConfig(...) call from 'void/config'.

norms.quote: Commit `void.config.ts` and `void.lock.json` when Void creates the lock; it records resource IDs and migration history.
norms.norm: Commit void.lock.json (it records resource IDs and migration history).
norms.detect: Version-control state.

norms.quote: Use relative imports or package names inside `void.config.ts`. TypeScript path aliases such as `@/lib/theme` are not supported.
norms.norm: In void.config.ts import only relative paths or packages; never TypeScript path aliases such as '@/lib/theme'.
norms.detect: In void.config.ts an import specifier starting with '@/', '~/', '#' or matching a tsconfig `paths` alias. Aliases without a recognizable prefix escape unless tsconfig is read.

norms.quote: The shorter JSON fragments below show individual fields to place inside `defineConfig({ ... })`.
norms.norm: Write config fields as TypeScript object properties inside defineConfig({...}), not as separate JSON files.
norms.detect: JSON configs are legacy files converted by void init; fragments are examples.

norms.quote: When set, those conventions move under the configured directory:
norms.norm: With sourceDir set, keep pages/, routes/, middleware/, crons/, queues/, db/, auth.ts and env.ts under that directory (void.config.ts, vite.config.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, public/ and .env stay at root).
norms.detect: With sourceDir configured in void.config.ts, a convention directory (routes/, pages/, middleware/, ...) or auth.ts/env.ts found at the project root. Needs the sourceDir value.

norms.quote: Void does not scan both locations
norms.norm: Never keep source conventions in both the project root and sourceDir; remove one copy.
norms.detect: Both <root>/routes (or pages, db, ...) and <sourceDir>/routes exist (filesystem check).

norms.quote: Use `auth.providers` to select which built-in auth providers Void should enable by default.
norms.norm: Provide credentials for each social provider as AUTH_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID and AUTH_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_SECRET (cognito also AUTH_COGNITO_DOMAIN, AUTH_COGNITO_REGION, AUTH_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID).
norms.detect: Secrets and env live outside the file.

norms.quote: If `auth` is omitted but auth is active via imports, Void enables email/password only.
norms.norm: To enable social providers list them in auth.providers; for provider options, scopes, plugins or custom OAuth use auth.ts with defineAuth.
norms.detect: Which providers the product needs is intent.

norms.quote: Supported values for `auth.providers`:
norms.norm: Use only supported values in auth.providers: email, apple, atlassian, cognito, discord, dropbox, facebook, figma, github, gitlab, google, huggingface, kakao, kick, line, linear, linkedin, microsoft, naver, notion, paybin, paypal, polar, railway, reddit, roblox, salesforce, slack, spotify, tiktok, twitch, twitter, vercel, vk, zoom.
norms.detect: Any string literal in the auth.providers array of defineConfig that is not in the list.

norms.quote: Database backend. Omit for D1/SQLite (default). Set to `"pg"` or `"mysql"` for an external database through Hyperdrive.
norms.norm: Set `database` to nothing, 'pg', 'mysql' or an object { dialect, casing, readReplication }.
norms.detect: `database` literal other than omitted, 'pg', 'mysql' or an object whose dialect is 'sqlite'|'pg'|'mysql', casing 'snake_case'|'camelCase', readReplication boolean.

norms.quote: D1 only. Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) [read replication]
norms.norm: Set database.readReplication only for D1 (dialect sqlite/omitted).
norms.detect: A database object with dialect 'pg' or 'mysql' that has readReplication.

norms.quote: Add `DATABASE_URL` to `.env` for local development
norms.norm: For an external database add DATABASE_URL to .env for local development.
norms.detect: Not source code.

norms.quote: Import schema helpers from `void/schema-pg` or `void/schema-mysql`
norms.norm: For pg/mysql projects import schema builders from 'void/schema-pg' or 'void/schema-mysql', not drizzle-orm/pg-core or mysql-core.
norms.detect: In db/schema* files an import from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core' or 'drizzle-orm/mysql-core' (dialect needs void.config.ts; for D1 the doc names no helper module).

norms.quote: | `from` | `string` | Default sender for `sendEmail()`: one address, optionally with a display name
norms.norm: email.from is one address, optionally with a display name (Acme <noreply@mail.acme.com>).
norms.detect: email.from literal that is not a single address or `Name <address>`. Address validity is approximated by regexp.

norms.quote: Without `email.from`, Void skips automatic setup and preserves authored `cloudflare.send_email` bindings and `cloudflare.addresses`; check their readiness yourself.
norms.norm: Set email.from for automatic Cloudflare mail setup; without it verify send_email bindings and addresses yourself.
norms.detect: Needs Cloudflare account state.

norms.quote: | `titleTemplate` | `string`                 | Wraps the resolved title. `%s` is replaced with the page title.
norms.norm: Include %s in head.titleTemplate.
norms.detect: A head.titleTemplate string literal with no '%s'.

norms.quote: Dynamic pages need [`getPrerenderPaths()`](../guide/ssg.md#per-page-overrides) to be prerendered.
norms.norm: Export getPrerenderPaths from dynamic pages that should be prerendered (output 'static' or prerender = true).
norms.detect: A pages/ .server file with a [param] path segment and `export const prerender = true` but no getPrerenderPaths export. Under output 'static' without the flag the config is needed.

norms.quote: Individual pages can opt into deploy-time prerendering with `export const prerender = true`, or opt out of server-rendered component HTML with `export const ssr = false`.
norms.norm: Declare per-page prerender and ssr overrides as `export const prerender = true|false` / `export const ssr = false` with boolean literals.
norms.detect: An export named prerender or ssr whose initialiser is not a boolean literal. The literal requirement is inferred from the shown form.

norms.quote: Use a deployed Void project's D1, KV, and R2 resources during local development. Writes affect real data.
norms.norm: Treat `remote` mode as live data: writes hit the deployed project's D1, KV and R2; require void account login and void project link.
norms.detect: Operational judgement.

norms.quote: Supported sizes are `lite`, `basic`, and `standard-1` through `standard-4`.
norms.norm: Set sandbox.instanceType to lite, basic or standard-1..standard-4.
norms.detect: sandbox.instanceType literal not in {lite, basic, standard-1, standard-2, standard-3, standard-4}.

norms.quote: registry images must be digest-pinned references from the Cloudflare managed registry.
norms.norm: Use digest-pinned (…@sha256:…) Cloudflare managed registry references for sandbox platformImage.
norms.detect: sandbox.platformImage literal without '@sha256:'.

norms.quote: Custom images must include the matching Sandbox SDK helper.
norms.norm: Include the matching Sandbox SDK helper in custom sandbox images.
norms.detect: Dockerfile content.

norms.quote: For a local Dockerfile, supply `platformImage` when deploying to a managed platform.
norms.norm: Set sandbox.platformImage whenever sandbox.image is a local Dockerfile and you deploy to a managed platform.
norms.detect: sandbox object with `image` and no `platformImage`; deploy target is unknown to the rule.

norms.quote: Sandbox requires [Workers Paid](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/workers/plans) and Containers access.
norms.norm: Use Sandbox only on Workers Paid with Containers access.
norms.detect: Account state.

norms.quote: Deploy target runtime. Defaults to `"cloudflare"`.
norms.norm: Set target only to 'cloudflare', 'node', 'bun' or 'deno'.
norms.detect: `target` literal not in those four.

norms.quote: Non-CF targets disable CF binding imports (`void/db`, `void/kv`, `void/auth`, `void/storage`, `void/ai`, `void/sandbox`, `void/env`). Importing any of these with a non-CF target produces a compile-time error.
norms.norm: With target node/bun/deno do not import void/db, void/kv, void/auth, void/storage, void/ai, void/sandbox or void/env.
norms.detect: The doc says importing any of these with a non-CF target produces a compile-time error.

norms.quote: Void-managed WebSocket route files (`*.ws.ts`) are Cloudflare-only because they compile to Durable Objects.
norms.norm: Do not create *.ws.ts WebSocket route files when target is not cloudflare.
norms.detect: Needs config plus file layout.

norms.quote: Supported hints are `apac` (Asia Pacific)
norms.norm: Set storage.locationHint to apac, eeur, enam, weur, wnam or oc.
norms.detect: storage.locationHint literal not in {apac, eeur, enam, weur, wnam, oc}.

norms.quote: This only affects new buckets: changing the hint never moves or replaces an existing bucket.
norms.norm: Do not expect changing storage.locationHint to move an existing bucket.
norms.detect: Deployment state.

norms.quote: Put binding arrays such as `d1_databases`, `kv_namespaces`, and `r2_buckets` in
norms.norm: Put binding arrays (d1_databases, kv_namespaces, r2_buckets, ...) in `cloudflare`, not in `worker`.
norms.detect: `worker` object containing d1_databases, kv_namespaces, r2_buckets, services, durable_objects, queues or other binding arrays.

norms.quote: `worker.vars` values must be strings.
norms.norm: Make every worker.vars value a string.
norms.detect: A worker.vars object property whose value is not a string literal/template.

norms.quote: Production builds do not load `.env`, and reject any `worker.vars` name declared as a server key in `env.ts`.
norms.norm: Do not list a name in worker.vars that env.ts declares as a server key; use `void secret put` for production server values.
norms.detect: The doc says production builds reject any worker.vars name declared as a server key in env.ts.

norms.quote: A remote secret with the same name takes precedence. To use the configured variable instead, remove that remote secret and deploy again.
norms.norm: A remote secret overrides a same-named worker.vars value; remove the secret to use the variable, in a maintenance window.
norms.detect: Remote state.

norms.quote: `worker.limits.cpu_ms` sets the CPU time limit per request, from 1 to 300000 ms.
norms.norm: Keep worker.limits.cpu_ms between 1 and 300000.
norms.detect: cpu_ms numeric literal < 1 or > 300000 or non-integer.

norms.quote: On a Void platform, deploy fails if the limit exceeds the account plan; lower it in `void.config.ts` before retrying.
norms.norm: Keep worker.limits.cpu_ms within the account plan ceiling (Workers Free 10 ms); a Void platform deploy fails above it.
norms.detect: The doc says deploy fails if the limit exceeds the account plan.

norms.quote: The complete Cloudflare Worker configuration for direct Cloudflare builds and deployment. Put custom bindings, `name`, `account_id`, routes, services, vars, migrations, and any other Cloudflare fields here.
norms.norm: Put custom bindings, name, account_id, routes, services, vars, migrations and other Cloudflare fields in `cloudflare`.
norms.detect: Top-level key of defineConfig (or `worker` key) named name, account_id, routes, services, migrations, d1_databases, kv_namespaces, r2_buckets, etc.

norms.quote: Root `wrangler.jsonc` and `wrangler.json` are migrated on `void init` or `void deploy`; Void keeps backup copies under `.void/config-migration/`.
norms.norm: Do not keep wrangler.jsonc/wrangler.json at the root; move the settings into void.config.ts.
norms.detect: Non-JS config file.

norms.quote: If you need to remove a value that Void previously generated, remove it from the `resolved` object in `void.lock.json`.
norms.norm: To drop a value Void generated earlier remove it from `resolved` in void.lock.json; put ongoing settings in `cloudflare`.
norms.detect: Lock file editing.

norms.quote: Direct Cloudflare deploys use `staged` by default: Void checks the new Worker before sending it production traffic.
norms.norm: Set deploy.cloudflare.mode only to 'staged' or 'atomic'.
norms.detect: deploy.cloudflare.mode literal not in {staged, atomic}.

norms.quote: This choice applies to subsequent `void deploy` runs. Atomic deployment sends traffic to the new Worker before Void checks readiness; a Durable Object class migration cannot be rolled back across its migration boundary.
norms.norm: Choose atomic mode only after reviewing pending Worker and database changes; Durable Object class migrations cannot be rolled back.
norms.detect: Risk judgement.

norms.quote: `deploy` is a Void setting and is not passed to Cloudflare's Worker config.
norms.norm: Put `deploy` at the top level of defineConfig, not inside `cloudflare`.
norms.detect: A `deploy` key inside the `cloudflare` object.

norms.quote: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS with a permanent `308` redirect. Omitted or `false` means off. Requires the Cloudflare target.
norms.norm: Use routing.alwaysUseHttps only with the Cloudflare target.
norms.detect: routing.alwaysUseHttps true together with a target literal other than 'cloudflare' in the same file.

norms.quote: The default is `false`; `void init` enables it for new apps.
norms.norm: Enable routing.typedRoutes to check URL strings against your routes.
norms.detect: Project policy choice.

norms.quote: Custom response headers. Keys are URL patterns, values are arrays of `"Name: value"` strings.
norms.norm: Give routing.headers values as arrays of 'Name: value' strings.
norms.detect: routing.headers entry whose value is not an array of string literals matching /^[^:]+:\s*.+$/.

norms.quote: URL redirects. Keys are source URL patterns, values are destination strings (302 default) or objects with `to` and optional `status`
norms.norm: Give routing.redirects values as a destination string or { to, status } with status 301, 302, 303, 307 or 308.
norms.detect: A redirects value that is an object without `to` or with a status literal outside {301,302,303,307,308}.

norms.quote: URL rewrites. Keys are source URL patterns, values are destination paths.
norms.norm: Give routing.rewrites and routing.fallbacks destination paths that start with a single '/'.
norms.detect: A rewrites/fallbacks value string literal that does not start with '/' or starts with '//' (the single-slash rule is stated for runtime c.rewrite only).

norms.quote: Fallback rewrites. Same shape as `rewrites`, but rules only fire when no static asset or route matched the request
norms.norm: Use routing.fallbacks for rules that must not pre-empt real routes; rewrites fire before routes.
norms.detect: Needs routing intent.

norms.quote: Setting it to `false` disables ISR and edge prerendering for the whole app, including per-page exports:
norms.norm: Do not set routing.isr false while also relying on revalidate or prerender settings; they are disabled.
norms.detect: routing.isr false together with routing.revalidate or routing.prerender in the same config, or page exports of revalidate/prerender elsewhere.

norms.quote: ISR revalidation TTL in seconds, either globally or per path.
norms.norm: Give routing.revalidate as a number of seconds or an object mapping patterns to seconds.
norms.detect: routing.revalidate value that is not numeric/object-of-numeric.

norms.quote: When omitted, ISR cache keys drop every incoming query parameter to avoid unbounded cache fanout.
norms.norm: List query params that change a page's output in routing.revalidateQueryAllowlist, otherwise ISR cache keys drop them.
norms.detect: Which params affect output is page knowledge.

norms.quote: Paths to prerender as static HTML at deploy time. Each path must start with `/`.
norms.norm: Start every routing.prerender path with '/'.
norms.detect: routing.prerender array literal containing a string not starting with '/'.

norms.quote: In `void.config.ts`, annotate the array with [`RouteUrl`](./api/types.md#route-types) so TypeScript checks the paths
norms.norm: Annotate routing.prerender with `satisfies RouteUrl[]` (import type { RouteUrl } from 'void/routes') when typedRoutes is on.
norms.detect: routing.prerender array literal not wrapped in `satisfies RouteUrl[]` while routing.typedRoutes is true in the same file.

norms.quote: Override how the asset layer answers a request that matched no asset and no worker route. One of `"single-page-application"`, `"404-page"`, or `"none"`.
norms.norm: Set routing.notFound to 'single-page-application', '404-page' or 'none'.
norms.detect: routing.notFound literal outside those three.

norms.quote: SvelteKit, Nuxt, Analog, and Astro use their own error pages and ignore this setting.
norms.norm: Do not set routing.notFound for SvelteKit, Nuxt, Analog or Astro apps (ignored); set a complete asset policy in the framework's Cloudflare config for TanStack Start, React Router, vinext.
norms.detect: Needs framework detection from package.json.

norms.quote: Auth and checked-in migrations still require a database even when `db` is `false`.
norms.norm: Do not set inference.bindings.db false in an app that uses auth or has checked-in migrations; the database is still required.
norms.detect: Needs awareness of auth use across files.

norms.quote: Each binding accepts `true` (use default name), `false` (disable), or a string (custom binding name):
norms.norm: Give each inference.bindings key (db, kv, storage, ai) true, false or a string; `email` is boolean only.
norms.detect: inference.bindings value not boolean/string for db|kv|storage|ai; a string for email; a key outside db, kv, storage, ai, email.

norms.quote: Custom AI names also work with `void/ai` on direct Cloudflare deploys; managed Workers AI uses the platform's proxy.
norms.norm: Custom AI binding names work with void/ai only on direct Cloudflare deploys; managed Workers AI uses the platform proxy.
norms.detect: Deployment mode.

norms.quote: Override which directories are scanned for [binding inference](./resource-inference.md). Paths are relative to the project root.
norms.norm: Give inference.scanDirs project-root-relative paths (not absolute).
norms.detect: scanDirs entry starting with '/' or containing a drive letter.

norms.quote: App type. If omitted, auto-detected on first deploy.
norms.norm: Set inference.appType only to 'void', 'framework', 'static' or 'spa'.
norms.detect: inference.appType literal outside those four.

norms.quote: Only relevant when `inference.appType` is `"spa"` or `"static"`. Defaults to `"dist"`.
norms.norm: Set inference.outputDir only when inference.appType is 'spa' or 'static'.
norms.detect: outputDir set while appType is a literal other than spa/static in the same file.

norms.quote: Import Void's app-facing APIs from these paths:
norms.norm: Import Void's APIs only from the documented app-facing import paths.
norms.detect: An import declaration, export-from, dynamic import() or require() whose specifier is `void/<something>` and is not one of the documented paths (`publicModules` in this file, taken from the table on this page and the reference pages). Paths the docs never name, such as `void/_env` or `void/pages-client`, are reported.
